routes.family_slots: Active route. Preserve the complete source family sequence, retain support/contact in source order, and sort proximity and vertical-order candidates independently by source score times compatibility.
routes.pv_global: Direct matched constraint control. Preserve every support/contact slot and support/contact identity, but merge proximity and vertical-order candidates into one queue sorted by the same source score times compatibility.
routes.support_order_only: Use source score for support/contact and product utility for proximity and vertical-order, sort all candidates globally, and preserve only the relative source order of support/contact rows.
routes.all_families: Scope comparison. Apply source score times compatibility to every family and sort globally, including support/contact.

evaluation_scope: This post-hoc matched routing analysis isolates the family-slot constraint on the fixed candidate pool and compatibility estimators. It does not select a replacement route, establish dataset-level generalization, or interpret all-family sorting as a directly comparable main method.
